note: Illustrative shape example pinned by P-0014; timestamps, identifiers, subjects, and digests are not compatibility constants.

server_derived_material.blind: a fresh uniformly random 32-byte value generated before the serializable transaction and reused across internal retries of the one application attempt; never caller-selected
server_derived_material.subject_commitment: BLAKE3-256 derive-key commitment over the exact protected preimage with blind, subject, and Workspace

public_binding_shape.fact_digest: the binding record digest of the public commitment-only record

protected_opening_shape.exclusion: excluded from ordinary logs, Problems, ContextPacks, exports, and public evidence

outcome_rules.allow: success committing both paired facts and resolving the exact subject at login
outcome_rules.unpinned_issuer_configuration: input schema mismatch when issuer_configuration_digest differs from the deployment-pinned issuer
outcome_rules.duplicate_active_subject: authorized application failure with problem code proof.state.conflict at the locked snapshot when an authentication-valid private binding already carries the exact subject
outcome_rules.changed_re_presentation_same_principals: IdempotencyConflict under the Workspace-global successful-application key rule
outcome_rules.identical_replay: IdempotentReplay disclosing the prior result without duplicate facts
